title: Supported maintenance path when an Unknown checkpoint's recovery-attempt storage (65,536) is exhausted
outcome: When an Unknown original checkpoint exhausts its finite recovery-attempt storage (65,536 allocated attempts), an operator has a supported, explicitly designed maintenance and representation path. It preserves custody and explicit capacity backpressure, never reuses PossiblySent attempts, and has a classified persistence floor if it needs one.
acceptance: Supported maintenance path when an Unknown checkpoint's recovery-attempt storage (65,536) is exhausted is done
